name: Time zoom
oneLiner: one continuous camera dives through a timeline on a glass rail: a decade of activity dots, then one year, one week, one day, the scale gliding in log space with a short hold at each level while ticks and labels re-form like a map; the target span glows in the accent before each dive and the camera lands on a single accent dot, where a needle rises and a glass pill names the moment and its time
say: when the speaker pins a turning point inside a long stretch of time ('ten years of posting, and it all changed on one Thursday night'): cut in on the long view, the pin lands on the word that names the moment
